title: Game of Thrones — The king who never wanted the crown

hook.context: Stark xonadonining shiori: qiyin kunlar albatta keladi, tayyor turish kerak. Present Continuous bu yerda kelajakdagi muqarrar voqeani bildiradi.

reading: Westeros is a land where summers and winters can last for years. Seven kingdoms, which are ruled by one king, fight for power and the Iron Throne.
Ned Stark is the lord of Winterfell, a cold castle in the North. He is a man who always tells the truth and keeps his word.
His old friend, King Robert, asks Ned to come to the capital and become his chief advisor. Ned accepts, although he hates the city, which is full of lies.
In the capital Ned discovers a secret that could destroy the queen's family. The people whose power depends on the secret decide to stop him.
Meanwhile, across the sea, Daenerys Targaryen, whose family once ruled Westeros, receives three dragon eggs as a wedding gift.
In the far North, beyond a huge wall of ice, there are ancient creatures that most people think are only stories.
The show teaches a hard lesson: in the game of thrones, the person who plays honestly is not always the person who wins.

grammar.title: Relative clauses: who, which, that, whose, where
explain: Relative clause otni aniqlashtiradi: **who** — odam (a man **who** tells the truth), **which** — narsa/hayvon (the city, **which** is full of lies), **that** — odam yoki narsa (creatures **that** people think are stories).
**whose** — egalik, "kimningki": Daenerys, **whose** family once ruled Westeros. **where** — joy: a land **where** winters last for years.

**Defining** (vergulsiz) — qaysi biri ekanini aniqlaydi, ko'pincha that bilan almashtirsa bo'ladi: The man **who/that** plays honestly... **Non-defining** (vergul bilan) — qo'shimcha ma'lumot, **that ishlatilmaydi**: Ned, **who** is honest, goes to the capital.
Agar relative so'z gapning to'ldiruvchisi bo'lsa, uni tushirib qoldirish mumkin: The book (**that**) I read was long. Lekin ega bo'lsa — mumkin emas: The man **who** called you...

exercises.q: Ned is a man ___ always tells the truth.
Winterfell is the castle ___ the Starks live.
Daenerys, ___ family once ruled Westeros, has three dragons.
The capital, ___ is full of lies, is dangerous.
This is the sword ___ I told you about.
exercises.why: Narsa, defining → that/which (tushirib qoldirsa ham bo'ladi).

exercises.q: The people ___ power depends on the secret decide to stop him.
I've lost the book ___ you gave me.
exercises.why: you — ega, book — to'ldiruvchi; relative so'zni tushirish mumkin.

exercises.q: Westeros is a land ___ winters can last for years.
